operations.content: TrailCode/Graft in Hermes is pinned to @nanonets/graft@0.15.0 via scripts/trailcode*.cmd wrappers that cd into the indexed repo first. Newer 0.25.x serves deferred tools this client reads as empty; the server only sees the repo in its working folder, so an index must exist there (graft build) or queries return nothing.

n8n MCP (https://neodevstudio-n8n.hf.space/mcp-server/http) supports OAuth DCR at /mcp-oauth/register, but Hermes needs a fixed callback: set mcp_servers.n8n.oauth.redirect_port (e.g. 18923), register that exact http://127.0.0.1:PORT/callback, save client_id/secret, then user runs hermes mcp login n8n in their own terminal. Token auth via headers works as fallback.

Supabase broad-door MCP URLs (no project_ref, 6 feature groups) require an explicit project id on every call; main project_ref iovbjaljwxwxchumnyoc. Tavily runs via shared rotator F:/CD/Opencode/.opencode/tools/tavily-rotator/launcher.mjs with TAVILY_DEFAULT_DEPTH=advanced.
